# BaseJobQueue.handler property

The handler registered by `onPop`<!-- -->, if any.

**Signature:**

```typescript
protected handler?: JobQueuePopHandler<U>;
```

## Remarks

Doubles as the readiness flag on [JobQueue](/api/job/latest/job.jobqueue/)<!-- -->, whose `start` and `push` both refuse to run while it is unset.
